code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Find the full-length straight divider.
    line=None
    for r,row in enumerate(g):
        if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=5:
            line=('h',r,row[0]); break
    if line is None:
        for c in range(w):
            vals={g[r][c] for r in range(h)}
            if len(vals)==1 and next(iter(vals))!=7:
                line=('v',c,g[0][c]); break
    orient,pos,_=line
    bg=5 if 5 in sum(g,[]) else 7
    objs=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and not (g[r][c]==line[2] and (r==pos if orient=='h' else c==pos))]
    color=g[objs[0][0]][objs[0][1]]
    rs=[r for r,c in objs]; cs=[c for r,c in objs]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    # Translate the object as a rigid pattern until its nearest edge touches divider.
    if orient=='h':
        if r1<pos: dr=pos-1-r1; dc=0; stripe=r0+dr-1
        else: dr=pos+1-r0; dc=0; stripe=r1+dr+1
    else:
        if c1<pos: dc=pos-1-c1; dr=0; stripe=c0+dc-1
        else: dc=pos+1-c0; dr=0; stripe=c1+dc+1
    moved=[]
    for r,c in objs:
        moved.append((r+dr,c+dc,g[r][c]))
        g[r][c]=bg
    for r,c,v in moved: g[r][c]=v
    if orient=='h' and 0<=stripe<h:
        g[stripe]=[8]*w
    elif orient=='v' and 0<=stripe<w:
        for r in range(h): g[r][stripe]=8
    return g
'''
